name: Light's Chosen converts Agility and Intellect (#1816)
contract: Light's Chosen 301310 promises spell power from 50% of Agility, critical strike rating from 15% of Intellect, and spell penetration from 10% of Intellect. The first two are native stat auras. The third runs through a 5-second periodic trigger of 301369, whose own effect carries a fixed amount, so the talent's 10% of Intellect must reach it. A level 80 Templar has well over 20 Intellect, so the applied amount must exceed 2.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The periodic penetration aura is applied
Penetration is a tenth of Intellect, not a flat point
